adapter_proof: Command adapter indices are retained before paste-review adapters are created; selected queue capture uses its command index, not the last hidden question adapter. Child captures target the newly created live question adapter.
successor_scope: After existing parent-Cancel retirement assertions, old command Copy/Paste/Add/Delete/Apply/Cancel and old review Yes/No/Cancel cannot change clipboard, complete Manager, successor executable/rows/selection/example/feedback/message, command/review/call/Options slot identity or visibility.
